subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar accept this four-PR shadow-lineage architecture and its promotion contract now, while keeping legacy accounting authoritative until stronger parity evidence exists?
rationale: Accepting a new accounting authority, cache namespace, containment policy, and future promotion boundary is a product and compatibility choice that cannot be resolved from technical correctness alone.

options.title: Accept guarded shadow stack
options.body: Review and merge the prerequisites in order, retain legacy as the default, and make future lineage promotion a separate evidence-backed maintainer decision.

options.title: Narrow to diagnostics
options.body: Keep validation and performance diagnostics while deferring the selector, cache-mode, and promotion architecture.

options.title: Pause the rearchitecture
options.body: Continue with the merged file-local containment and gather broader real-world lineage evidence before carrying this stack.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded shadow stack
recommendation.body: Review and merge the prerequisites in order, retain legacy as the default, and make future lineage promotion a separate evidence-backed maintainer decision.
